title: Chapter 555 - 555 Arrival; Visit
content:
Chapter 555 - 555 Arrival; Visit

Chapter 555 - 555 Arrival; Visit

555 Arrival; Visit

Lin Xiaoyao, Lin Tao, and Dai Weixue listened to Liu Zihao’s praise of Lin Fan. Their hearts were filled with joy and pride.

Their family was the pride of Hua Nation!

At this moment, Liu Zihao said, “Professor Lin, there’s something else… I wonder if I can negotiate with you?”

Lin Fan asked, “What is it?”

Lin Zihao said, “The TV station has sent a group of reporters. They want to broadcast tomorrow’s Nobel Prize ceremony live. They know that you don’t like to be exposed, so they promised not to record you.

“So, I came to ask for your opinion.”

Generally speaking, this kind of live broadcast only needed the approval of the Nobel Prize organizers.

Why would they need the consent of the winner?

Furthermore, they would not film Lin Fan.

However, Liu Zihao received a notice that he had to ask Lin Fan.

The media had already been informed that Lin Fan did not like to show his face or be exposed.

How glorious was it to win four Nobel Prizes at the same time? It could definitely be called a historic moment!

Logically speaking, it had to be recorded and broadcasted live… but because of Lin Fan’s preferences, the rules changed.

It had to be said that the TV station had shown Lin Fan the greatest respect.

Lin Fan nodded. “It’s fine as long as they don’t film me.”

Just as the reporters thought, he really did not like exposure.

However, it was not a problem for them to avoid shooting his face.

In addition, the reporters’ good attitude also made Lin Fan feel satisfied.

When Lin Zihao heard this, a look of joy appeared on his face.

A moment later, the three Audis stopped at the Royal Hotel.

The Royal Hotel today was much livelier than usual today. There were many cameras at the entrance, and the flashes were constantly going off at the many men and women in suits and leather shoes entering and leaving the hotel.

When the reporters saw Liu Zihao and Lin Fan, they could not wait to focus their cameras on them.

Dense flashes of light rained down on them.

“Are you Professor Lin Fan?”

“How do you feel about winning four Nobel Prizes?”

“Which direction will you research in the future?”

“How do you usually study?”

“You…”

Countless questions flooded in.

It caused the entrance of the Royal Hotel to become noisy.

Even though Lin Fan had never been exposed in any media before, the reporters recognized Liu Zihao.

Moreover, they knew that Liu Zihao would be picking Lin Fan up today.

Thus, they could easily determine Lin Fan’s identity.

Lin Fan ignored all of these questions.

Firstly, he did not like to be interviewed. It was troublesome.

Secondly, he never liked to answer English questions. These reporters all asked questions in English.

After some time, Liu Zihao finally led Lin Fan, Lin Xiaoyao, and the others through the door and toward the luxurious suite.

The reporters were disappointed.

However, very soon, they were filled with excitement again.

This was because they had obtained photos of the most mysterious genius, Lin Fan!

However, when they opened the memory card, they realized that all the photos and videos of Lin Fan had disappeared.

Did they forget to store them?

The reporters could not help but feel regretful.

How would they know that everything was deleted by the super smart watch?

…

After Liu Zihao sent Lin Fan, Lin Xiaoyao, and the others into the luxurious suite, he did not stay there for long.

He knew that Lin Fan had just taken a ten-hour flight and needed to rest.

After Liu Zihao left, Lin Xiaoyao looked at the wide, bright floor-to-ceiling window and the blue sea in the distance. She could not help but shout excitedly.

“Wow! Brother, this hotel is amazing!”

It was so beautiful!

“Brother, quickly come and take a few photos for me.”

Lin Fan smiled and said. “Alright.”

Soon, Lin Xiaoyao stood up and said, “Brother, what kind of photos did you take for me? Are my legs that short?

“Also, I blinked. Why didn’t you say anything?”

Lin Fan rubbed his nose helplessly.

It was so difficult to be an elder brother.

After a while, the crisp doorbell rang outside.

“Respected Professor Lin, hello. I hope I didn’t disturb your rest.” At the door, a blonde blue-eyed middle-aged man spoke in fluent Chinese.

Lin Fan said, “Hello, may I know who you are?”

“I’m Desmartin, the chairman of Des Energy.” The middle-aged man continued, “Do I have the chance to invite you to the cafe on the third floor for a cup of coffee?”

The chairman of Des Energy?

If it were an ordinary person, they would definitely be shocked when they heard this name.

Even if this ‘ordinary person’ was a Nobel Prize winner!

This was because Des Energy was the number one giant in the oil and chemical industry!

Des Energy was not listed, and its exact financial report was a secret.

However, even Apple, Google, and other companies were nothing in front of it.

One could imagine just how terrifying its power was.

Lin Fan raised his eyes and said, “Sorry, I don’t like coffee. If you have something to say, you can just say it here.”

Desmartin was slightly stunned. He had probably never invited anyone for coffee before only to get rejected.

After a while, he said, “Professor Lin, from the earthquake prediction device, the human islet recovery drug, the carbon-based photolithographic machine, the super batteries, and other high-tech products that you invented… I know that you’re a great scientist who protects the environment and loves peace!”

Lin Fan frowned and asked, “So, why are you looking for me?”

Desmartin seemed to sense that Lin Fan was getting impatient.

Therefore, he went straight to the point. “We, Desi Energy, have the most chemical and energy materials in the world. We can expand and promote super batteries in the smoothest and fastest way. We can allow the world to use and embrace clean energy faster and make the earth’s environment better as soon as possible…

“I wonder if you have any plans to sell the battery patent? We, Des Energy, are willing to spend 500 billion USD to buy the patent.”

First, he said that it was for the sake of mankind and the environment.

Then, he offered a sky-high price of 500 billion USD.

Great righteousness and great benefits!

It had to be said that Desmartin had good negotiation skills.

If it were an ordinary person, they might really be tempted.

However, Lin Fan just said calmly, “Sorry, I don’t.”

After saying that, he returned to his room and closed the door.

Sell?

Firstly, Lin Fan had no intention of selling the patent. He was not short of money. So what if he had an extra 500 billion USD? It would just add a little more to his account.

Secondly, even if he were to sell it, he would definitely not sell it overseas.

As for the nonsense about the environment and the earth, Lin Fan threw it to the back of his mind.

If he loved the environment and the earth so much, would it not be better to shut down all the factories of Des Energy immediately?
